_doc: GD-26 C-06 band file (02 s18.3, R0 B.25 A-128). The 02 band is band.one_flak_survive_min 60 (% of Bombers that release with one Flak) and band.two_flak_die_min 80 (% that die before release with two). one_flak_survive_min / two_flak_die_min are the regression floors the test enforces: the 02 band for a half that is met (two Flak: measured 98 %), else the measured rate minus 10 points, floored at 0 (A-128; one Flak: measured 0 %), with the measured rates in `measured`. 'band open: GD-34' = the 02 band is missed under valid preconditions; GD-34 retunes the anchors by data and restores the floors to the band. Lives in test/sim/balance/, not test/sim/scenarios/: tools/schemas/sim_scenario.schema.json (additionalProperties false, the TA-33 runner) cannot hold these keys.

shipped_bands_pin._doc: BUG-2 (sim_ai): with the shipped bands the Bomber drops to the DECK band (deck_alt_agl_m 60) once a Flak covers the target, under flak_battery h_rel_min 150, and the 6 km horizon limits the defenders' sight to about 850-940 m, so A-128's first-seen >= 1,500 m precondition fails. Known-bug pin: test_c06_known_bug_bug2_shipped_bands_fly_under_the_flak_floor asserts these numbers and fails when the bug is fixed; BUG-2 must update or remove it.
